field.name: help
field.p: Conclusions are reusable blocks of text printed after the totals on a quotation — typically Availability, Terms of Payment, Delivery, Guarantee, and the closing salutation. Pick one on a Sales Order and edit the copy per-quote if needed.

field.name: help
field.p: Introductions are reusable blocks of text printed at the top of a quotation, between the customer address and the order lines. Pick one on a Sales Order and edit the copy per-quote if needed.

field.name: help
field.p: By default, it contains a list and a form view and possibly other view types depending on the options you chose for your model.
You can start customizing these screens by clicking on the Studio icon on the top right corner (you can also customize this help message there).
